title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode6 Street SEKAI

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An event?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah. Now that you're a group, why not?
We should perform together as artists who have a shared vision.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's an event we're part of next month that had one of their performers back out, so they've got an empty slot to fill.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's at a live house called RED. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: RED, huh? It's kinda on the small side, so it might be good for a first performance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What do you think, Kohane?
It's a good opportunity, and I can't wait for people to hear us sing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But next month is so soon... Will I be all right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You'll be fine! If it's next month, we'll have plenty of time to practice. Besides, I'll be right there with you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right. If we're singing together, that means I won't be up there by myself.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think...I can handle that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's settled, then. I'll let them know you'll be there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks for the invite, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't mention it. This'll be our first time performing at the same event. I'm looking forward to it.
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
What was that all about, Akito?
Why did you invite them out of the blue like that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did you know I played soccer until I started junior high?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Before I knew it, my skill made me the best on the team. And even though I was never really into it, the expectations of those around me made me think I wanted to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I realized something the first time I went up against a nationally ranked team. Those who have their eye on a goal are on a completely different level.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whether it's free time, eating, or even sleep, those kinds of people will sacrifice everything to work toward their goal.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seeing RAD WEEKEND was the first time I felt like I'd found something I could sacrifice everything for.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I always thought Shiraishi was the same way.
After all, she was there too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'd hoped she was different than all the others who like to talk big, and that she really wanted to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But now she's gone and teamed up with a complete amateur.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's no way she can surpass that night teamed up with some timid, half-hearted noob like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So I'm going to teach her a lesson. We'll overwhelm them with our performance, and make sure they realize that they don't have what it takes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...Akito, don't you think it's a bit early to assume they're only doing this half-heartedly?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Were you even paying attention to that kid?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
She said she's only ever sang during music class.
Someone like her doesn't even have the right to use RAD WEEKEND's name.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Saying you're going to surpass that night...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Isn't something you can say half-heartedly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And that is why we'll crush them with our singing.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that we've decided to be part of an event, we should figure out what we're going to sing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That was great! And it looks like you can handle the more difficult songs without any problem. You really are amazing, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: N-No, I'm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's probably good for a list of possible choices.
Are there any other songs you can think of?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, what do you think about this song done by Miku?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, this one's really cool!
Sure, let's add it to the list.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's a song in the playlist that doesn't have a title.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, you're right. It just says Untitled.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I bet there was a problem with the download or something. Try playing it to see which one it is.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay. Huh? I don't hear anything.
I guess it must not have downloaded all the way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane... Is it just me or is your phone glowing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Is it? You're right. The title is starting to—
ah! I can't see!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa, that scared me. W-What just happened?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!!
Um, wh-where are we?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't recognize this street. We were just in the cafe, weren't we? How did we get outside?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I know, we can check the map on my phone.
Huh? I-It's not working... Wh-What's going on?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm... Why don't we take a look around?
Maybe we'll find a familiar street.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay. I don't recognize this place, but somehow I still get the feeling I've seen it before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You too? I get the same feeling.
It kind of reminds me of Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look! This is a RAD WEEKEND flyer!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What's it doing here?
Dad said they all disappeared after the event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hey, An! There's a shop over there!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. It looks like a cafe. Let's go ask them for directions.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Excuse me! Is there anyone here?

Welcome. Oh, there you are.
You've finally come to visit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Miku?!
